notes: Every Wednesday with games is assumed to be a promo day ($2M, one King: DK's usual purse; Rudy says when it differs) unless listed in `skip`. Add an entry to `promos` after each Wednesday: `winners` are the players DK paid (ESPN ids), `payout` is the bonus bet each winning token received, in dollars (null = not published). An entry also overrides the default format or pool (e.g. a Three Kings night).
